description: This is a PHP test class 'UniqueLangStringTest' that verifies the uniqueness of language string values and unit IDs within the 'OrangeHRM' system, specifically testing the 'I18NLangString' entity to ensure no duplicate language strings or unit IDs exist, with some exclusion for certain unit IDs.

classes.name: UniqueLangStringTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case for verifying the uniqueness of language strings and unit IDs in the 'OrangeHRM' system

methods.name: testUniqueValue
methods.description: Tests that all language string values are unique, throwing an exception if duplicates are found

methods.name: testUniqueUnitId
methods.description: Tests that all unit IDs, except certain exempted ones, are unique, throwing an exception if duplicates are found
